headline: ELK RANGE MAIDEN HOLE HITS 89.6M AT 5.5 G/T — Idaho Friday Mine First Assays In; High-Grade Core 11.3M at 21.4 G/T
source_name: Elk Range Minerals / InvestSmart ASX Announcements
snippet: Elk Range Minerals (ASX: ELK) received first assays from its maiden drill hole at the Friday gold mine in Idaho, returning 89.6 metres at 5.5 g/t gold with a high-grade core of 11.3 metres at 21.4 g/t from 137.2m depth, confirming and extending the high-grade system below historical workings. The Phase 1 program targets extensions across eight diamond drill holes totalling approximately 2,850 metres, with remaining hole results still pending.

headline: BRAZILIAN RARE EARTHS MONTE ALTO RESOURCE UP 41% TO 3.5MT AT 10.7% TREO — ASX:BRE SURGES 7% ON UPGRADE
snippet: Brazilian Rare Earths (ASX: BRE) released an updated indicated resource at its Monte Alto project showing a 41% jump to 3.5 million tonnes at 10.7% total rare earth oxides, maintaining the ultra-high grade that makes it one of the richest rare earth deposits outside China. The announcement drove a 7% single-day share price gain to A$1.85 on the ASX, with the deposit open along strike and at depth.

headline: PURECORE: AI DATA CENTRES ARE PUSHING URANIUM DEMAND PAST ALL FORECASTS — Nuclear Supply Squeeze Builds Through 2030
snippet: Purecore's October 2026 uranium market report, published today, tracks the accelerating impact of AI data centre electrification on nuclear power demand, finding that new reactor builds and operating lifetime extensions are pushing uranium consumption well above pre-2025 baseline forecasts. With long-term uranium prices above $96/lb and spot above $89/lb, the report argues supply additions will be insufficient to prevent a structural deficit by the early 2030s.

headline: TOP 50 MINERS SHED $264 BILLION AS GOLD TRADE UNWINDS — Lithium Stocks Among Q3's Biggest Exits
snippet: Mining.com's Q3 2026 update on the world's 50 largest miners by market cap shows a combined $264 billion decline as gold gave back much of its 2026 gains and institutional money exited lithium companies on the disconnect between elevated long-term demand forecasts and near-cycle-low spot prices. The combined sector valuation fell to approximately $2.0 trillion, reversing most of the first-quarter surge.

headline: WARABA GOLD ADDS 1,141 DRILL HOLES AND 67,600M OF DATA — Acquires 80% Tengrela PR-683 Licence Adjacent to Côte d'Ivoire Project
snippet: Waraba Gold agreed to acquire an 80% interest in the Tengrela PR-683 licence in Côte d'Ivoire from a subsidiary of Desert Metals, consolidating a large, data-rich block adjacent to its existing Tengrela gold project with over 1,141 historical drill holes and 67,600 metres of drilling already completed. The deal adds a near-shovel-ready exploration block with existing target definitions at no additional drilling cost.

headline: AUREKA SHAREHOLDERS GREENLIGHT HIGH GRADE HOLDINGS DEAL — Producing Fiddlers Creek Gold Mine and Wedderburn Mill Acquired
snippet: Aureka shareholders voted to approve the acquisition of High Grade Holdings, owner of the producing Fiddlers Creek gold mine and the Wedderburn gold processing mill in Victoria, Australia, with transaction completion expected around October 30. The deal gives Aureka immediate cash-flowing production assets to complement its exploration portfolio.

headline: NORTHERN STAR SIGNALS OPENNESS TO IMPROVED GOLD FIELDS BID — A$38.7B OFFER REJECTED; REVISED PROPOSAL EXPECTED AFTER LATE-OCTOBER ROAD SHOW
snippet: Mining.com's October 26 Gold SWOT notes that Northern Star Resources has signalled openness to an improved Gold Fields takeover offer after unanimously rejecting the initial A$38.7 billion approach as materially undervaluing the company. Gold Fields concluded its late-October Australian investor road show this week, with investors briefed by the company expecting a revised, more cash-rich offer to follow shortly.

headline: NEWMONT 'STANDOUT' AMONG OVERSOLD GOLD MINERS — Sector Could Fall Another 20-30% Before Liquidation Floor Found
snippet: Investing.com's October 26 analysis identifies Newmont as the standout name in an oversold gold mining sector, citing its Q3 2026 results beat and stronger relative cost control, but cautions that the broader GDX could fall another 20-30% in a liquidity-driven liquidation scenario even with gold holding near $4,000. A confirmed sector bottom has not yet been established.

headline: LITHIUM STOCKS SNAP BACK ON ASX — PLS SURGES 8%, LIONTOWN 6% AS BARGAIN HUNTERS TARGET OVERSOLD BOUNCE
snippet: Australian lithium miners staged a sharp bounce on the ASX on October 26, with Pilbara Minerals (PLS) gaining more than 8% and Liontown Resources adding over 6% as bargain hunters stepped in after lithium carbonate prices fell approximately 27% in a single month. The bounce is attributed to tactical positioning ahead of monetary policy decisions rather than any fundamental shift in the supply picture.

headline: GOLD TESTING $4,000: WHICH 10 JUNIOR MINERS ARE POSITIONED TO REBOUND FIRST?
snippet: With spot gold testing the key $4,000 psychological level ahead of the FOMC decision, FinWire screens 10 junior mining stocks best positioned for a rebound, focusing on companies with fully-funded drill programs, defined resources, and catalysts within 60-90 days. The list prioritizes names that have fallen 30-50% from their 2026 highs while maintaining strong project fundamentals.
